description: Monthly scheduled and non-scheduled aircrafts traffic by type, year and airline is a series of data sets listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset presents monthly statistics on scheduled and non-scheduled aircraft traffic by type, year, and airline in the State of Qatar. It includes the number of arrivals and departures of flights operated by Qatar Airways and other airlines from 2014 to 2015. Coverage: Qatar. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are aircraft, airlines, aviation. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-08-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and air transport studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
